basic_profile.bio: I'm a recent college graduate from Texas, currently working as a junior software developer. I discovered Reddit while searching for communities to discuss cryptocurrency and various hobbies. I enjoy playing mobile games like 'The Wild Darkness', and I'm a huge Foo Fighters fan. In my free time, I dabble in investment strategies, particularly in cryptocurrencies. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work. I'm single and enjoy connecting with like-minded people online.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and a growing interest in cryptocurrency, which I started exploring after a college friend introduced me to it. Most of my knowledge is self-taught through online resources and community discussions.
